sv.title: Rivers, 14, dog – nu stäms sociala medier-jättarna
sv.summary: Det sista hon såg var en instruktion i hur man tar livet av sig • Pappan: ”De fick henne att ifrågasätta sig själv.”

en.title: Rivers, 14, died – now the social media giants are being sued
en.summary: The last thing she saw was an instruction on how to take her own life • Father: “They made her question herself.”
